purpose: Evaluate next-session-open to fifth-session-close endpoint returns independently from complete daily-path and actionability diagnostics; make morning and afternoon intraday signals comparable under one daily target.
candidate_membership: No feature, threshold, ranking, candidate-pool, or selection changes. Keep each preselected row, including unresolved rows; no substitution and no daily cap.

target.entry: Open of the next official XTKS business session after the signal date.
target.exit: Close of the fifth official XTKS business session after the signal date, counting the entry session as session one.
target.entry_exit_price_source: Already available daily OHLCV only; no 1-hour or 4-hour fill prices.
target.signal_time_effect: Signal time within the signal date does not alter entry date, entry price, exit date, or exit price.

endpoint_label.required_prices: Positive finite entry-session open and fifth-session close on the exact calendar dates.
endpoint_label.intermediate_daily_bars: Not required to calculate endpoint mark-to-market; missing interior sessions remain explicitly path-incomplete.
endpoint_label.volume: Does not erase the endpoint mark-to-market result; zero or unknown entry/exit/interior volume is exposed as an execution-quality diagnostic.
endpoint_label.missing_or_invalid_endpoint: Keep row unresolved with a target-specific status; never forward-fill or jump sessions.

path_and_execution_diagnostics.strict_label: Retain existing build_five_session_labels unchanged; inspect all five official daily bars and preserve its OHLCV, volume, gap, and split-size checks.
path_and_execution_diagnostics.interpretation: A resolved endpoint return is not proof of intraday path, queue priority, limit execution, liquidity, or executable fill. Endpoint and strict-path metrics must be reported separately and may not share a metric label.
path_and_execution_diagnostics.incomplete_path: Expose exact strict-path status, including missing or invalid intermediate bars and zero-volume sessions; do not represent as path validated.

evaluation_scope.unit_tests: Synthetic daily bars, including separate morning and afternoon signals and missing interior sessions.
evaluation_scope.retrospective_audit: Only previously exposed 2022H2 and 2023 discovery rows from the latest completed CMF flow-acceleration audit, if its frozen local artifacts are present and hashes validate.
evaluation_scope.selection_policy: No parameter tuning or model promotion. Historical outputs remain RETROSPECTIVE_PROVISIONAL.

required_report: target-specific candidate requested/resolved/unresolved counts and status counts
endpoint return summary with cost sensitivities
metric parity between endpoint and strict-path labels on rows resolved by both
prohibited: Mixing endpoint-only and strict-path outcome rows or labeling them with the same target id
Synthesizing hourly or four-hour bars from daily data
Opening 2024, 2025, or 2026 outcomes for this audit
Changing candidate membership after seeing labels
External price fetching or Yahoo scraping
